notes: 配置同步面板五点交互调整：工作区展开后显示会话名称（从 session/title 提取，带缓存）；加「修改」按钮，点了才可切状态；点工作区整行即展开；工作区显示卡片移到问题反馈前；标题吸顶 + 快速跳转标签点击平滑滚动到对应卡片。
notesEn: Five panel interaction refinements: show session names when a workspace is expanded (from session/title, cached); an Edit button that must be clicked before states can change; click the whole workspace row to expand; the Workspace visibility card moved just above Feedback; a sticky title bar with quick-jump tabs that smoothly scroll to each section.
